review: B08 S05/S06 What's New private candidate read-only Security/Data Integrity/Architecture
verified_static_scope: visibleReleases still shows only releases.first in automatic mode and all ordered releases in manual mode; source release order and feature iteration are unchanged.

Version text remains verbatim and version badge uses the original release.version; area badge title, tint, symbol, feature title/summary, artwork selection, and row/detail navigation remain unchanged.
The candidate adds only Dynamic Type layout changes, capped content width, scroll bounce behavior, and untruncated summary at accessibility sizes.
onPresented remains attached to view onAppear. Automatic Done button and dismiss action remain unchanged; manual mode still has no Done toolbar action.
Unread badge persistence and automatic dismissal marking are owned by WhatsNewStore, WhatsNewManager, DUNEApp, and NotificationHubView; none are changed by this candidate.
No new user-facing string keys, model writes, network/HealthKit access, secret material, or external state are introduced.
remaining_uncertainty: The maximum Dynamic Type version header, feature row and detail header require native layout and accessibility verification after application.
The 680-point width cap on iPad/Duo needs actual capture confirmation.
